entities.name: Kinzu
entities.description: Phyrexian Vampire of New Phyrexia who infects victims with glistening oil to make them murderous puppets.

entities.name: Vraan's Bleak Coven
entities.description: Coven of silent vampire assassins to which Kinzu belongs.

events.summary: Kinzu turns phyresis to her advantage, infecting victims' minds and bodies with glistening oil to make them kill for her.
events.quote: turning them into murderous puppets that kill for her and perpetuate her vicious goals.

relations.note: Kinzu is a vampire assassin of the coven.
